question: 'Triticum aestivum' is the scientific name of_____________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Wheat.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Triticum aestivum** is the most widely cultivated species of wheat, used for bread making.
 
• It belongs to the **Poaceae** (grass) family and is essential for staple cereal grains like wheat, rice, and maize.
 
• Wheat is a key source of carbohydrates, providing a **large** portion of the world's food supply.
 
• It thrives in temperate climates and is grown globally, with major producers being** China**, **India**, and **Russia**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Monkey**

 
 
• Common monkeys, like the rhesus macaque, have the scientific name **Macaca mulatta.**
 
• Monkeys belong to the **primate order**, sharing evolutionary traits with humans such as opposable thumbs.
 
 
 
• **Mango**
 
 
• Mango is a tropical fruit with the scientific name **Mangifera indica.**
 
• Mango holds cultural and economic significance in India as the national fruit and is widely consumed.
 
 
 
• **Human**
 
 
• Humans are classified under the species **Homo sapiens** in the animal kingdom.
 
• Humans are part of the **primates** order, closely related to other species like monkeys and apes in evolution.
